name: Lima bean

schedule.notes: Soil MUST be 65+ F or seeds rot. Wait longer than for bush beans.
Pick fresh when seeds bulge but pods still green. Or let dry on plant for dried limas.

harvest.cues: Pods plump, seeds visible through the wall. Pods should still snap if pulled.
harvest.storageNotes: Fresh: fridge 5 days, or shell and freeze. Dried: shell at full pod-brown, store airtight years.

varieties.name: Fordhook 242
varieties.notes: Standard butter bean. Heat-tolerant bush type.

varieties.name: Christmas
varieties.notes: Maroon-and-white speckled. Sprawling pole vine. Striking dried bean.

notes: Needs hot summers — disappointing harvests in cool coastal climates. Pole types yield twice the bush types but need a 6 ft trellis.
